podcast.body: This "bubble gum adjacent" song by The Jackson 5 was at number one on the charts but was subsequently knocked out of the top spot by David Cassidy's "I Think I Love You" on November 21, 1970. "It knocked out I'll be there by the bubble gum adjacent Jackson five."

podcast.body: This hit song by the Jackson 5 prevented The Carpenters' version of "We've Only Just Begun" from reaching the number one spot on the Hot 100 in 1970. "We've Only Just Begun" was consequently held at number 2, getting "stuck behind" "I'll Be There." "It got stuck behind the Jackson 5's I'll Be There."
